# ApiVoy v0.2.0 — Interface lifecycle & workbench polish

Second public release after `v0.1.0`.

## Highlights

- Interface design lifecycle (design → debug → validate → sync)
- JSON tree editor for nested request/response fields
- Unified request/response layouts across protocol workbenches
- Security and CI hardening (`h2` advisory, CodeQL fixes, installer health contract)
- Maintainer PR review checklist for front-loaded quality gates

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.
